comments.quote: 名宿位置不算特別明顯，門口的招牌特別顯眼，免費停車，有遮陽網，很涼快，房間特別乾淨，庭院非常優美，餐廳二樓有個小涼亭，早上看日出非常完美。
comments.author: Guest User
comments.quoteEn: The house is not especially obvious but the sign at the gate is. Parking is free and under shade netting, so it stays cool. The rooms are very clean and the courtyard is lovely. There is a small pavilion on the first floor of the restaurant, which is perfect for watching the sun come up.

comments.quote: 老闆和老闆娘特別熱情，進去需要換鞋，有一種家的親切感，早飯是老闆娘親自做的，鹹菜筍乾特別好吃，早餐搭配也很精緻健康！
comments.author: Doudingmiaoqi
